rules.title: Relocation Assistance for Tenants Displaced by Eviction
rules.requirement: Landlords must provide relocation assistance payments to tenants displaced by eviction, with amounts depending on tenant income and length of tenancy. Payments must be made within 15 days of eviction notice or placed in escrow for tenant relocation expenses.
rules.summary_plain: If your landlord evicts you, they must pay you relocation assistance based on your income and how long you've lived there. They must pay within 15 days or put the money in an escrow account for your moving costs.
rules.summary_plain_es: Si su arrendador lo desaloja, debe pagarle asistencia para la reubicación según sus ingresos y el tiempo que haya vivido allí. Deben pagar dentro de 15 días o depositar el dinero en una cuenta de depósito en garantía para sus gastos de mudanza.
rules.coverage_conditions_text: Applies to tenants displaced by eviction in the City of Los Angeles, including low income tenants and tenants in single-family dwellings owned by natural persons with no more than four units.
rules.exemptions_text: Relocation assistance is not owed if the eviction is due to a governmental agency order to vacate or comply for an unpermitted dwelling. Landlords may offset tenant's accumulated rent against relocation assistance owed.
rules.quoted_span: The City Ordinances requires that relocation assistance payments be made as follows: ... Payments shall be made available within fifteen (15) days of service of the written notice of eviction; however, the landlord may ... elect to pay the monetary relocation benefits through an escrow account.
